adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an `addGuests` mutation that appends new rows to `booking.attendees` via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` and then sends emails / updates calendar attendees. Nowhere in the diff is a `BookingSeat` model/table referenced, nor is there any evidence in this change that adding “guests” is supposed to create seat records (as opposed to simply adding attendees on an existing booking). The presence of `seatsPerTimeSlot`/`seatsShowAttendees` on the `CalendarEvent` object doesn’t, by itself, prove a required invariant that every attendee must have a `BookingSeat` row or that seat-limits must be re-enforced when adding guests. Therefore the claim about missing `BookingSeat` records and broken seat-based flows is not verifiable from this diff and is speculative.
